apps.name: Tubi
apps.blurb: Free ad-supported streaming with a large back catalogue of films and TV. No account is needed to start watching.
apps.availability: US, Canada, Mexico, UK, Australia and several Latin American markets

apps.name: Pluto TV
apps.blurb: Hundreds of free live channels arranged like traditional TV, plus an on-demand library of films and series.
apps.availability: Around 30 countries across the Americas and Europe, including the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and Brazil

apps.name: Plex
apps.blurb: Plex streams thousands of ad-supported films and series plus hundreds of free live channels. The paid Plex Pass only adds features for your own media library.
apps.availability: Free catalogue reaches more than 180 countries, though individual titles vary by territory

apps.name: YouTube
apps.blurb: The free ad-supported tier carries official channels from broadcasters, leagues and studios, including free films, live streams and full documentaries. Premium is optional and only removes ads.
apps.availability: Worldwide

apps.name: The Roku Channel
apps.blurb: Roku's own free service mixes an on-demand film and series library with hundreds of free live channels. No Roku hardware is needed on web or mobile.
apps.availability: US, Canada and the UK on Roku devices, web and mobile; Mexico on Roku devices only

apps.name: Samsung TV Plus
apps.blurb: Samsung's free channel service is built into its TVs, with live channels and an on-demand film library. It needs no account and no subscription.
apps.availability: 23 countries on Samsung smart TVs; the mobile app covers 11 of them

install.smart-tv: Already built into Samsung smart TVs from 2016 onwards — open it from the home row, there is nothing to install.
install.phones: Galaxy phones only, running Android 8.0 or later, in selected countries.
install.tablets: Galaxy tablets only, running Android 8.0 or later, in selected countries.

apps.name: LG Channels
apps.blurb: LG's free live channel service is pre-installed on its smart TVs. The line-up is set per country, so it differs from market to market.
apps.availability: 33 countries, on LG smart TVs from 2019 onwards

install.smart-tv: Built into LG webOS TVs — open LG Channels from the home screen, there is nothing to install.

apps.name: Rakuten TV
apps.blurb: Rakuten TV runs a free ad-supported section with hundreds of live channels and on-demand titles, alongside a separate paid rent-and-buy store.
apps.availability: Around 40 European countries, including the UK, Ireland, Germany, France, Spain, Italy and the Nordics

install.consoles: PlayStation 4 and 5 in 16 European markets, plus Xbox One — check your console's store for your country.

apps.name: Xumo Play
apps.blurb: A free service built around live channels, with several hundred streams plus an on-demand catalogue of films and shows.
apps.availability: US; Canada on Rogers and Shaw Ignite boxes; UK on Sky Glass and Sky Stream only

apps.name: Red Bull TV
apps.blurb: Free live and on-demand action sport, motorsport and music, alongside a deep library of sport documentaries.
apps.availability: Worldwide

install.consoles: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S and Xbox Series X — search your console's store for "Red Bull TV".

apps.name: DAZN
apps.blurb: A free DAZN account unlocks a set of always-on sport channels covering boxing, darts, motorsport and more, plus the FIFA+ football library. Marquee events stay behind the paid tier.
apps.availability: Free channels in every DAZN market, though the free line-up varies by country

apps.name: Olympics
apps.blurb: The International Olympic Committee's own app carries Olympic news, highlights, original series and sport documentaries. Live rights are held by local broadcasters, so live coverage depends on where you are.
apps.availability: Worldwide on iOS and Android; live event coverage varies by territory

apps.name: ARTE.tv
apps.blurb: The Franco-German public culture channel streams documentaries, reportage, concerts and arthouse cinema free of charge, subtitled in seven languages.
apps.availability: Free across Europe in English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Romanian and Spanish; some titles are limited to France and Germany

apps.name: DW (Deutsche Welle)
apps.blurb: Germany's international broadcaster streams a 24-hour news channel plus an on-demand library of documentaries on politics, science, culture and sport. No account or subscription is required.
apps.availability: Worldwide

apps.name: NHK WORLD-JAPAN
apps.blurb: Japan's public broadcaster streams its international channel live around the clock, with most programmes also available on demand. It is free and needs no sign-in.
apps.availability: Worldwide, with subtitles and audio in 19 languages

apps.name: Al Jazeera English
apps.blurb: A free 24-hour news channel with a strong current-affairs documentary strand, streaming live and on demand.
apps.availability: Worldwide; a small number of programmes are not cleared for the US

apps.name: Kanopy
apps.blurb: Arthouse films, world cinema and documentaries streamed with no ads. It is free if your public library or university subscribes — you sign in with your library card.
apps.availability: US, Canada, UK, Australia and New Zealand, through participating libraries and universities

apps.name: hoopla
apps.blurb: Borrow and stream films and TV series with a card from a participating public library. There are no ads and no fee.
apps.availability: US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, through participating libraries

apps.name: BBC iPlayer
apps.blurb: Live and catch-up streaming of every BBC channel, with a deep archive of drama, documentaries and sport.
apps.availability: UK only; a TV licence is required to watch

apps.name: ITVX
apps.blurb: ITV's streaming service offers thousands of hours free with ads, covering drama, films and live sport. The paid Premium tier only removes ads and adds BritBox.
apps.availability: UK only

apps.name: Channel 4
apps.blurb: Free catch-up and live streaming from Channel 4, with a large documentary and drama archive. It is advertiser-funded, so there is nothing to pay.
apps.availability: UK only

install.consoles: PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Xbox One — search your console's store for "Channel 4".

apps.name: 5 (My5)
apps.blurb: Channel 5's free streaming service carries live channels plus catch-up drama, documentaries and factual series.
apps.availability: UK only

install.consoles: PlayStation 4 only — there is no Xbox app.

apps.name: SBS On Demand
apps.blurb: Australia's multicultural broadcaster streams free world cinema, subtitled drama, documentaries and selected live sport.
apps.availability: Australia only; the old PlayStation and Xbox apps were retired, so use a TV or streaming device

apps.name: ABC iview
apps.blurb: The Australian public broadcaster's free service, carrying live channels plus catch-up drama, factual and documentary programming.
apps.availability: Australia only

apps.name: 9Now
apps.blurb: Free live streams of the Nine network channels plus catch-up episodes and sport coverage.
apps.availability: Australia only

apps.name: CBC Gem
apps.blurb: Canada's public broadcaster streams live channels, drama and documentaries free with ads. The paid tier only removes the ads.
apps.availability: Canada only

install.consoles: Xbox One and Xbox Series S|X only — there is no PlayStation app.

apps.name: SABC+
apps.blurb: The South African public broadcaster streams its free-to-air TV channels, sport and radio, with catch-up on top. A paid tier adds extra content.
apps.availability: South Africa; SABC News, radio and podcasts stream worldwide

apps.name: ViX
apps.blurb: The largest Spanish-language free service, with novelas, films, news and live sport. A separate premium tier is optional.
apps.availability: US, Mexico and 16 other Spanish-speaking countries in Latin America

apps.name: Viu
apps.blurb: Asian drama, Korean series and local originals with a free ad-supported tier. The paid tier adds the full catalogue and higher quality.
apps.availability: 16 markets across South-East Asia, the Middle East and South Africa

apps.name: TVer
apps.blurb: The joint catch-up service of Japan's commercial broadcasters, carrying drama, anime, variety and documentaries free with ads. No account is needed.
apps.availability: Japan only
